name: get_text
description: Fetch a passage of Jewish text from Sefaria by reference, in Hebrew and/or English. Works for Torah/Tanakh, Talmud, Mishnah, Midrash, Halacha, Kabbalah, and commentaries. Keyless.

name: lookup_ref
description: Validate or autocomplete a Sefaria reference or title (e.g. "Genesis", "Rashi", "Berakhot"). Returns whether it is a valid reference/book and a list of completions. Keyless.

name.description: A partial title or reference to validate/autocomplete.

name: get_commentaries
description: List the commentaries and cross-references on a passage (e.g. Rashi, Targum, quoting commentaries) from Sefaria's link graph. Keyless.

category.description: Filter to links of this category, case-insensitive (e.g. "Commentary", "Targum"). Default "Commentary".
